name: The Shilla Seoul
positioning: Luxury hotel in Seoul's Jung-gu district on Namsan, with a Clé de Peau Beauté Spa and curated cultural experiences
best_for: Travelers who want a Seoul base close to the green paths of Namsan
Guests interested in Korean culture, art and modern Korean cuisine

facts.text: The hotel's address is 249 Dongho-ro, Jung-gu, Seoul.
The hotel offers a jogging course along a forest path on Namsan.
The hotel has a Clé de Peau Beauté Spa.
After a spa treatment, guests can relax with signature tea in the spa's Resting Lounge, which overlooks Namsan.
The hotel lists a cultural experience at Leeum Museum of Art among its guest experiences.
Guests can enjoy a curated selection of authentic local experiences inside the hotel.
The hotel has an Executive Lounge.
La Yeon serves a modern reinterpretation of traditional Korean cuisine.
The Library is a lounge and bar with live jazz.

highlights.text: A jogging course follows a forest path on Namsan, right from the hotel.
At the Clé de Peau Beauté Spa, guests relax after treatments with signature tea in a Resting Lounge overlooking Namsan.
The hotel lists a cultural experience at Leeum Museum of Art among its guest experiences.
Guests can enjoy a curated selection of authentic local experiences inside the hotel.
La Yeon serves a modern reinterpretation of traditional Korean cuisine.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hillside location limits walkability to some attractions.
WhataHotel notes a premium price point among Seoul's luxury hotels.
